圖中所示為一正四面體 $ABCD$。求平面 $ABC$ 與平面 $BCD$ 間之交角，準確至最接近的度。
A. 48°
B. 53°
C. 60°
D. 71°
reasoning: The dihedral angle between any two faces of a regular tetrahedron is given by \(\arccos\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)\) which equals approximately 70.53°. Rounding to the nearest degree yields 71°, so the correct choice is D.
